method: Each official PDF in data/raw/pdf is parsed by page coordinates (pypdf visitor, flipped CTM applied). Every player row is checked against the PDF's plain text extraction and, where a stored .txt exists, against it. A cell that cannot be placed is listed in problems, never guessed.
latest_release_gap: The 2026-11-17 capture index (data/raw/refresh_2026-11-17/capture_index.json, retrieved 2026-11-17T15:52:00Z) names an official release Injury-Report_2026-11-17_10_30AM.pdf. That PDF is not stored in the repository and cannot be fetched from this sandbox. Not inferred.
